_note: Declarative constraint shapes checked on every parsed intent (SHACL-style: target slice + property + condition + severity). severity: error = invalid value (blocks submit), conflict = KPI contradicts the classified slice (blocks submit unless force=true, asks for clarification), warning = unusual but allowed. 'basis' says where a threshold comes from; 'assumption' thresholds are engineering choices aligned with the simulator twin (resource_layer/comm_twin.py), not values quoted from a standard.
sliceTypesBasis: 3GPP TS 23.501 standardized SST values (1 eMBB, 2 URLLC, 3 MIoT)

rules.message: latency must be between 0.1 ms and 60 s
bandwidth must be between 1 kbps and 100 Gbps
reliability must be a percentage below 100
device count must be a positive integer
a URLLC slice with a latency bound above 50 ms is not low-latency
more than 1 Gbps on a URLLC slice exceeds the twin's per-cell capacity (400 Mbps x 2 cells)
more than 10,000 URLLC devices in one area is unusual
a latency bound under 5 ms needs a URLLC slice
five-nines reliability is a URLLC characteristic
a latency bound under 10 ms contradicts massive low-power IoT
more than 50 Mbps contradicts low-rate massive IoT
five-nines reliability is unusual for massive IoT
